newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Rashid Hussain plans $250 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Rashid Hussain plans $250 mln bond issue.

text.p: Rashid Hussain Bhd is proposing an issue of at least $250 million in 10-year exchangeable bonds to be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Monday, the financial concern said proceeds from the bond issue together with other previously announced issues will be used to refinance the bridging loan for its acquisition of stakes in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd and P.T. Bank Niaga.

The 75 percent Kwong Yik Bank stake was bought from Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) for 2.16 billion ringgit, while the 20 percent interest in Indonesian P.T. Bank was purchased for 246.8 million ringgit.

Rashid Hussain said the actual size and terms of the exchangeable bonds would be determined in consultation with the issue's lead manager Morgan Stanley. The bonds will be exchangeable for shares of DCB Holdings Bhd, a unit owned by Rashid Hussain.

The proposed issue "will enable RHB to secure long-term funds at a low fixed cost as compared to its existing loans and other available sources of financing", and allow it to diversify its funding sources, the statement said.
The company said the proposed bond issue would not have any effect on its share capital or net tangible assets.
